[BSP reconstruction 0046a9f0]
Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(void), RET 0, on the {count, head, tail} list at scene database +14Ch. Empties the list: each node with a non-null [node+8] runs 00469010 then frees that block, otherwise it is unlinked; then the node itself is freed and the count decremented. Ghidra shows a single-node pop because the fall-through after the _free call at 00bf65ac is dropped by a no-return annotation; the listing gaps 0046aa17..0046aa21 and 0046aa52..0046aa5c decode to "add esp,4 / mov [esi+8],0" and "add esp,4 / cmp [edi],0 / jne 0x46aa00", the loop back edge. Called at entry of every 0046df00 pass and as the tail call of 0046aab0. Packet scene_file_reader, read-only analysis; see docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md.

Packet scene_file_reader, read-only analysis; see docs/SCENE_FILE_READER.md. | Packet cc2_scene_deferred_refs: +14Ch and +150h are one list, not two. +14Ch is the {count, head, tail} header this function takes as its this, +150h is that header's head pointer, and 0046aab0 walks the head and then tail-jumps here on this+14Ch, so the list it clears is the one it just drained. 00469610 confirms the header address: LEA ECX,[ESI+0x14c] at 0046965e with ESI the scene database. Node layout {prev +0h, next +4h, record +8h}; the record is destroyed by 00469010 and freed, then the node is freed and the count decremented, whatever the record's resolution outcome was. docs/SCENE_DEFERRED_REFS.md.
